Click, Watch, Repeat: A Visual Journey Through Ad Exposure

Ads by Platform: Who Wins Your Attention?

Bar chart showing the total number of ad exposures by platform. Platforms are displayed on the y-axis and sorted in descending order of exposure, while the x-axis shows the count of ads. Each bar is coloured using a pastel coral palette, with darker shades representing lower exposure and lighter shades representing higher exposure. The chart shows differences in how frequently ads appear across different platforms.

This plot shows how advertisement exposure is distributed across different platforms. By comparing total counts, it becomes clear that some platforms contribute significantly more to overall ad exposure than others. This suggests that users are not exposed to ads evenly across digital spaces, with certain platforms acting as dominant channels for advertising delivery.

Hourly Patterns in Ad Exposure

Line and area chart showing the number of ads seen across each hour of the day. The x-axis represents hours from 0 to 23, and the y-axis shows the count of ads per hour. A blue shaded area highlights overall ad exposure, with a blue line indicating the trend and orange points marking the hourly values. A legend distinguishes between the trend line and hourly data points. The plot shows how ad exposure changes throughout the day, including peak and lower activity periods.

This plot illustrates how ad exposure changes across different hours of the day. It reveals clear variation in advertising activity, with certain hours showing higher concentrations of ads than others. This suggests that ad delivery is time-dependent rather than uniform, indicating that advertisers may target specific periods when user activity is higher.

Do More Relevant Ads Hold Attention Longer?

Scatter plot showing the relationship between ad relevancy and duration. The x-axis displays relevancy scores, and the y-axis shows duration of ad exposure. Each point represents an individual ad and is coloured by platform type using a multi-colour palette. A trend line is included to show the overall relationship between relevancy and duration. The plot illustrates how ad viewing time varies with relevance across different platforms.

This plot explores the relationship between how relevant an ad is and how long it is viewed. It allows comparison across platforms while also showing overall trends between relevance and duration. The results help indicate whether more relevant ads tend to hold user attention for longer periods, providing insight into advertising effectiveness and engagement behaviour.
